_published_faq.name: How do I add Eedi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Eedi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://teacher-tools.eedi.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Eedi MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Eedi provides these MCP tools: search_questions and get_questions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Eedi?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Eedi in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.
Eedi requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Eedi is developed by Eedi Ltd. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
